stream.window_rule: window [start, end) closes when watermark >= window_end + grace; wall clock never advances watermark
scope_notes: open_order_windows / closed_order_windows aggregate ALL products together (the engine does not split order windows by product). They must NOT be presented as figures of a single product.
by_product_orders is the per-product view: disposition 'accepted' includes orders that sit in still-open windows; 'late' orders were rejected from windows and are shown separately.
review windows (open_review_windows / closed_review_windows) ARE per product.

reasons: batch revenue = paid orders in ILS; the stream contract has no payment-status field and money is in agorot
product ids: stream uses [] which are all present in the batch product table [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] (ids are matchable)
order_id overlap between sources: 0 (batch range 1002-1599); no shared orders found
source_comparison.instruction: report batch and stream metrics separately; do not add them

available_metrics: stream windows, late events, alerts, checkpoint, watermark

snapshot.freshness_rule: values in this package are current as of taken_at_utc; they override older numbers from chat history
